outlook.statement: The Company remains focused on strengthening its business model by evaluating opportunities on the basis of their commercial viability, risk profile and long-term sustainability. The Board of Directors will continue to monitor developments in the commodity markets and assess opportunities for selective participation where market conditions are favourable. In parallel, the Company has increased its focus on the capital markets as an additional avenue for deployment of funds.

risks: Operating environment for commodity business remained challenging
Operational efficiency influenced by availability and cost of manpower, transportation infrastructure and supporting resources
Increased competition from larger market participants in commodity segment
Regulatory changes including relaxation of restrictions on institutional participation in commodity markets by SEBI
Reduced opportunities and impact on returns from commodity-related activities

Any future non-compliances or nonperformance may occur in the event of non-receipt of such approvals, consents or any other events which may occur in future beyond the control of the management or company.
Market risk including currency risk, interest rate risk and price risk
Credit risk on trade receivables, loans, cash equivalents and investments
Liquidity risk managed through cash flow generation and bank loans
